newsitem.title: ITALY: San Paolo buys up Fondiaria unit.
newsitem.headline: San Paolo buys up Fondiaria unit.

text.p: Italy's largest banking group Istituto Bancario San Paolo di Torino said it and insurer La Fondiaria Assicurazioni had agreed in principle on a restructuring of their jointly held San Paolo Vita SpA unit.
A joint statement said Fondiaria's Milano Assicurazioni would sell its 50 percent of San Paolo Vita to San Paolo bank for a total 225 billion lire.
San Paolo Vita had 1995 premium income of 363 billion lire, up 25 percent on 1994, with net profit of 14.5 billion against 3.1 billion.

On Monday, San Paolo banking group announced on Monday first half 1996 consolidated net profit up 34 percent at 321 billion lire and La Fondiaria announced first half group pretax profit of of 27.9 billion lire against 113.4 billion.
